candidate.definition_en: Action or performance of a task, or the effort and responsibility involved in bringing something about.
candidate.explanation_ar: الفعل أو العمل الذي يقوم به الشخص، أو بذل مجهود لإنجاز شيء، أو مسؤولية شخص عن حدوث أمر ما.

senses.definition_en: The action, activity, or effort involved in accomplishing something.
senses.definition_ar: القيام بالعمل أو بذل مجهود لإنجاز شيء ما.
examples: It will take some doing to fix this.
The doing of the task is more important than the planning.

senses.definition_en: Someone's personal responsibility or involvement in bringing about a result.
senses.definition_ar: مسؤولية شخص أو تدخله في حدوث أمر ما (من صُنعه أو فِعله).
examples: It was your doing, not mine.
It will take some doing to fix this.
It was your doing, not mine.
The doing of the task is more important than the planning.
